plan: Given my private value of $40, I aim to maximize profit by bidding strategically. Since values are independently drawn, I will bid slightly below my value to ensure potential profit if I win. A bid of $38 maximizes my chance to win while maintaining a buffer for profit, assuming the third-highest bid is lower. This strategy balances the risk of overbidding with the opportunity to win the auction at a profitable rate.

Given my value of $13, I aim to bid lower than my value to ensure a profit if I win. I will bid $8 to balance the risk of overpaying and the chance of winning. Assuming bids are uniformly distributed, a bid of $8 may win if the other bids are below $13. This strategy maximizes potential profit while minimizing loss if I win.

Given my private value of $17, I aim to bid strategically to maximize long-term profit. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid slightly above half my value to avoid overpaying. This conservative bid minimizes loss if I win and pay the third-highest bid. This approach balances the risk of winning with a low value and the potential loss of endowment. I will bid $8.5, as it is unlikely that both other bidders will bid below this, allowing a chance to win without overpaying significantly.
